subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should this PR land only after or together with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265 so newly collected missing persona TTS SecretRefs cannot turn previously non-blocking configuration into a Gateway startup failure?
rationale: The collection fix is mechanically correct, but activating previously ignored credentials changes upgrade and startup behavior; repository policy treats that fallback and failure-mode choice as maintainer-owned.

options.title: Sequence with optional TTS handling
options.body: Accept the optional missing-secret policy first, rebase this PR, and prove both successful persona resolution and localized missing-key failure on the resulting exact head.

options.title: Accept fail-closed activation
options.body: Land this PR independently and explicitly accept that existing missing persona TTS SecretRefs may begin blocking Gateway startup.

options.title: Pause collection change
options.body: Keep this PR open until the optional-TTS product direction is resolved and its final contract is known.

recommendation.title: Sequence with optional TTS handling
recommendation.body: Accept the optional missing-secret policy first, rebase this PR, and prove both successful persona resolution and localized missing-key failure on the resulting exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline repeatedly routes this secrets/TTS review and its product implications to steipete.
